description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Grav-Assault Force — FLARE SHIELDS (WP-C46): friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks active, P2 Custodes); setup privileges: P2 detachment Grav-Assault Force, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation, seeded dice, and the cus11e_c3_custodes_active fixture's Caladius Grav-tank (Sv 2+, GRAV-ASSAULT — copied verbatim from that save, the only fixture with a GRAV-ASSAULT unit) added to P2 at (320, 1800) px — the O34 Orks are the only fixture army with an AP-3 gun (the Mek Gunz' Smasha Gun), which is what makes the 4+ invulnerable save matter (2+ armour at AP-3 is a 5+). Shooting phase: a real click selects the Mek Gunz, Quick-Assign at the Caladius, Confirm, resolve: the save block rolls against 4+ INVULNERABLE (the 'inv' chip in the Dice Log) instead of the 5+ armour save.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description): the C3 Caladius joins P2
the Smasha Gun (AP-3) save block rolled against the 4+ invulnerable save, not the 5+ armour
